name: macd_histogram_divergence_v1
mechanism: When NIFTY experiences a sustained intraday decline, algorithmic momentum sellers execute in sequential waves. Each wave encounters better-rested resting buy orders at each new price low, causing the rate of decline to diminish even as price continues lower. The MACD histogram (12/26/9 on 5s bars ≈ 60s/130s/45s windows) captures this exhaustion precisely: a shallower histogram trough compared to the prior trough, while price prints a new low, reveals that NIFTY's net selling force is contracting. The histogram zero-cross above 0 then confirms that VWAP-benchmarked institutional buyers have begun active accumulation, producing a sharp 15-30 second bounce. The symmetric bearish divergence — higher price highs with lower histogram peaks — flags institutional buy-side exhaustion where resting sell orders at new highs are absorbing demand more effectively, preceding a sharp fade.
core_signal_oneliner: MACD histogram divergence at price swing extreme followed by histogram zero-cross confirming momentum exhaustion reversal
